Plot a single-peptide barplot

Source: R/functions.R
plot_barplot_single.Rd

Summarises peptide percentages by group and renders a single barplot with optional significance testing.

Usage

plot_barplot_single(
  data_merge,
  protein_name,
  peptide_name,
  add_signif = TRUE,
  color_palette = "viridis",
  y_limits = NULL,
  font_scale = 1,
  title_text = NULL
)

Arguments

data_merge

A processed data frame returned by percentage_calculation().

protein_name

Optional protein identifier used to subset the data.

peptide_name

Peptide identifier to plot.

add_signif

Logical; whether to add significance labels.

color_palette

Character palette name. Supported values are "viridis", "magma", "plasma", "inferno", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", and "turbo".

y_limits

Optional numeric vector of length 2 for the y-axis range.

font_scale

Numeric multiplier used to scale plot text.

title_text

Optional custom plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.
